description: Zones d'Epandage des STEP is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Location of the sludge application areas from the Purification Stations. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "STEP Spread Areas" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Epuration ; Boues ; Epandage ; STEP. The listing shows 2013-09-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
